title: Part 1 Practice: Definition & Scope of Economics

questions.text: The word 'Economics' originates from the Greek word 'Oikonomia'. What does 'Oikos' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Oikonomia' comes from TWO Greek words: 'Oikos' (household) and 'Nomos' (management/law). So economics originally meant 'household management.' Over time, it evolved to mean the study of how societies manage scarce resources.

questions.text: Who defined economics as 'a science which studies human behavior as a relationship between ends and scarce means which have alternative uses'?
questions.explanation: Lionel Robbins gave this famous definition in 1932. It emphasizes SCARCITY and CHOICE — the core of modern economics. His definition is widely accepted because it applies to ALL societies, rich or poor.

options: A) The overall economy and aggregate variables
B) Individual economic units like households and firms
C) Government fiscal and monetary policy
questions.correct_answer: B) Individual economic units like households and firms
questions.explanation: MICROeconomics focuses on INDIVIDUAL units — how a single household spends income, how one firm sets prices, how a specific market works. MACROeconomics looks at the BIG picture: GDP, national inflation, total unemployment.

questions.text: Which of the following is a POSITIVE economic statement?
options: A) The government should reduce taxes to help the poor
B) Unemployment is morally wrong and should be eliminated
C) Ethiopia's GDP grew by 7.2% last year
D) The central bank ought to lower interest rates
questions.correct_answer: C) Ethiopia's GDP grew by 7.2% last year
questions.explanation: POSITIVE economics deals with FACTS that can be TESTED and VERIFIED. 'GDP grew by 7.2%' is a factual statement that can be checked with data. Options A, B, and D are NORMATIVE because they express opinions about what SHOULD be done.

questions.text: Which of the following is a NORMATIVE economic statement?
options: A) Inflation is currently at 19% in Ethiopia
C) The government should provide free education for all
D) Coffee exports generate foreign exchange
questions.correct_answer: C) The government should provide free education for all
questions.explanation: NORMATIVE economics involves VALUE JUDGMENTS — what SHOULD BE. 'The government SHOULD...' is an opinion, not a testable fact. It cannot be proven right or wrong because it depends on personal values and political views.

questions.text: A researcher observes that every time coffee prices increase, consumers buy less coffee. After many observations, she concludes: 'Price and quantity demanded have an inverse relationship.' This is:
questions.explanation: INDUCTIVE reasoning moves from SPECIFIC observations to GENERAL conclusions. The researcher observed SPECIFIC instances (coffee price up → demand down) and formed a GENERAL law. Remember: INductive = IN from specific observations.

questions.text: An economist starts with the general principle 'people respond to incentives' and predicts that tax breaks for electric vehicles will increase EV purchases. This is:
questions.explanation: DEDUCTIVE reasoning moves from GENERAL principles to SPECIFIC conclusions. The economist started with a GENERAL theory (people respond to incentives) and applied it to a SPECIFIC case (EV tax breaks → more EV purchases). Remember: DEductive = DE from general principles.

questions.explanation: The diagram shows Specific → General, which is INDUCTIVE reasoning. You start with specific data/observations and build a general theory. This is how many scientific discoveries are made — observe patterns, then formulate laws.

questions.text: The scope of economics includes which of the following?
options: C) How individuals, businesses, and societies make choices
questions.correct_answer: C) How individuals, businesses, and societies make choices
questions.explanation: Economics is BROAD — it covers how INDIVIDUALS make personal choices, how BUSINESSES decide production, how GOVERNMENTS set policies, and how SOCIETIES allocate resources. It's not just about money; it's about CHOICE under SCARCITY in all areas of life.

questions.text: The term 'ceteris paribus' used in economics means:
options: D) Supply creates its own demand
questions.explanation: 'Ceteris paribus' is a Latin phrase meaning 'other things held constant.' Economists use it to isolate the effect of ONE variable while keeping all others unchanged. Example: 'Ceteris paribus, when price increases, quantity demanded decreases' — we assume income, tastes, and other factors don't change.
